tickets.title: Review and coordinate cash distribution request
tickets.text: Confirm the requested distribution amount, source account, destination, timing preference, tax withholding instructions, liquidity source, and any investment or retirement income impact before processing. Document Rowan Cloudpuddle authorization and retain confirmation after the distribution is completed. Process a $50,000 transfer to Rowan Cloudpuddle’s checking account ending in 7729 at Teacup Comet Bank and increase the monthly IRA distribution to $5,500, maintaining the existing 12% federal tax withholding.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to confirm the source account, destination account, liquidity source, and withholding instructions before processing, with a date of 2026-02-18.

tickets.title: Coordinate account access recovery
tickets.text: Use this coordination template when Rowan Cloudpuddle cannot access an account portal, custodian login, document vault, or authentication method. Confirm identity requirements, preserve security, and document all handoffs without collecting passwords. Rowan Cloudpuddle is unable to log into the Velvet Acorn Custody portal after changing mobile carriers.

subTasks.title: Confirm access problem and security boundaries
subTasks.text: Ask the client which portal is affected, what error message appears, whether multi-factor authentication changed, and what contact information is on file. Do not request or record passwords, full security answers, or authentication codes.

subTasks.title: Handoff to custodian or platform recovery channel
subTasks.text: Provide the client with the correct custodian or platform recovery path, required identification steps, and support contact method. If advisor involvement is permitted, confirm what authorization is needed before joining a call or submitting a service request.

subTasks.title: Verify restoration and update records
subTasks.text: After the client reports access is restored, confirm whether contact information, trusted contact, delivery preferences, or document access settings changed. Update internal notes and flag any suspicious activity for further review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is portal access recovery, with a date of 2026-02-13.

tickets.title: Collect care cost evidence for planning
tickets.text: Collect the facility rate sheet, deposit information, and Silver Marmot Insurance claim requirements needed for Rowan Cloudpuddle’s distribution planning. Obtain these documents by 2026-02-27 to support the cash draw estimate.
tickets.evidence: That evidence remains needed, with a date of 2026-02-27.

tickets.title: Coordinate tax withholding review with Talia
tickets.text: Coordinate with Talia Bramblequill to review Rowan Cloudpuddle’s tax withholding and estimated tax situation in light of the recent IRA distribution and proposed larger withdrawal. Ensure the withholding aligns with the household’s income mix and upcoming cash needs.
tickets.evidence: Rowan authorized coordination with Talia Bramblequill on a withholding and estimated tax check, and the agreed follow-up has a date of 2026-02-25.

tickets.title: Compare funding options for roof deposit
tickets.text: Compare using taxable money market funds, IRA cash, and the home equity line to fund the $26,000 roof repair deposit while preserving Rowan Cloudpuddle’s emergency reserve target. Provide a recommendation by 2026-02-16.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to compare using taxable money market funds, IRA cash, or the home equity line so the deposit can be funded without unintentionally reducing emergency reserves below Rowan’s stated minimum, with a date of 2026-02-16.

tickets.title: Update retirement income projection for household
tickets.text: Update the retirement income projection for Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton to reflect Elena’s reduced earned income, added in‑home assistance costs of $2,800 per month, and the increased IRA distribution of $5,500. Deliver the revised cash‑flow model by 2026-03-04.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to update the retirement income projection using lower earned income and higher care expenses, with a date of 2026-03-04.

tickets.title: Assess home equity and mortgage options
tickets.text: Assess whether paying down the home equity line, refinancing the mortgage, or retaining the current structure best aligns with Rowan Cloudpuddle’s cash reserve target and retirement income plan. Provide the analysis by 2026-03-11.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to assess whether paying down the line, refinancing, or leaving it in place is most consistent with the cash reserve target and retirement income plan, with a date of 2026-03-11.
